Image 1: Geometry/layout authority and edit target: keep every silhouette, position and size

Use case: sketch-to-render, game sprite sheet. Image 1 is the authoritative geometry guide and edit target: reskin it, keeping every shape exactly where and how big it is on the 1536x1024 canvas. It holds two separate objects for a sci-fi strategy-game building prop (like a tabletop miniature terrain set), each seen from directly above. Left: a raised bastion about one storey (four metres) tall built of stacked square barrier cells, seen from straight above: the cells on the north and west sides catch the sun and are light, those on the south and east are in shade and dark; it must read clearly as a tall solid block standing above the ground. A narrow staircase runs down the south side (keep the steps as drawn), crates on three deck corners; the deck holds an empty dark circular ring well (leave the well dark and plain: a separate rotating house sits over it). Right: the heavy rotating machinery house that sits on it: a slab-sided panelled housing with a chamfered front, a square front box, bolted side bins along both flanks, a hatch, a cupola, a rear grille, and one long heavy pipe with a slotted end cap pointing straight up the image. Material and style: Sindrian field-built works: the same sand-ochre export housings, dusty and dented, set in interlocking moulded plastic-composite barrier blocks in faded orange-red and off-white where the guide shows square cells, filled with sand, with oil drums and corrugated sheet patches; red unit bands sun-faded. Straight 90-degree overhead orthographic camera, top-down like a strategy-game map sprite, no perspective tilt. Sun from the upper left: keep the guide's lit and shaded faces exactly where they are. Hand-painted gritty science-fiction game-sprite look like Starsector, restrained palette, coarse readable detail that survives being shrunk to about 30 to 40 pixels per cell. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no UI, no ground or terrain, no grass, no cast shadow outside the objects, no extra slab, apron or border. Transparent background outside every silhouette (if transparency is impossible, a flat pure white background). Change only material, surface detail and subtle shading, never placement, size or silhouette.
